name: ide-jdtls
author: lumine-code
description: Provide Java language features with Eclipse JDT Language Server.

serverDirectory.title: Server Directory
serverDirectory.description: Absolute path to the extracted JDT LS distribution containing plugins and config directories. Leave empty to use the managed installation, then JDTLS_HOME or a system installation.

javaPath.title: Java Path
javaPath.description: Absolute path to a Java 21 or newer java executable. Leave empty to use JDK_HOME, JAVA_HOME, then PATH. Project build runtimes stay controlled by the project.

maxHeap.title: Maximum Heap
maxHeap.description: Maximum memory in MiB for each Java language server.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Offer to install JDT LS when its server or a supported Java runtime cannot be found.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which JDT LS features the editor uses. Reference lenses need a client command that the editor does not execute.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete Java names, methods and imports.

signature.title: Signature Help
signature.description: Show method parameters while entering arguments.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Navigate to project declarations, types and implementations.

references.title: Find References
references.description: Find symbol uses across the project.

typeHierarchy.title: Type Hierarchy
typeHierarchy.description: Navigate classes, interfaces and their inheritance.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename Java symbols across the project.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Classify Java symbols using semantic information.

parameterHints.title: Parameter Hints
parameterHints.description: Show hints for literal arguments, all arguments, or none. Server Default preserves JDT LS settings.

buildConfigurationUpdates.title: Build Configuration Updates
buildConfigurationUpdates.description: How JDT LS reacts to changed Maven or Gradle build configuration. Server Default preserves its policy.

formatterProfileUrl.title: Formatter Profile URL
formatterProfileUrl.description: Absolute file URL or HTTPS URL for an Eclipse formatter XML profile. Leave empty for the server default.

formatterProfile.title: Formatter Profile
formatterProfile.description: Profile name inside the configured formatter XML. Leave empty to let JDT LS select it.
